text:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime-pool-7 token-p99 latency >800ms for small completions across us-west. Queue depth rising, error rate starting to climb. Paging jamie (oncall).

jamie: i'm awake, pulling dashboards. what changed?

olivia: looks like sudden traffic pattern shift — a burst of lots of short requests interleaved with long streaming jobs. continuous batching is trying to pack everything and causing head-of-line blocking. GC in two nodes also spiked.

chen: confirmed: dataset shows a lot of 4-8 token prompts. current config batch_wait_ms=6ms, batch_target_size=24. With this mix the runtime keeps assembling suboptimal batches and latency balloons.

luis: customer impact: non-enterprise tenants (free/dev) seeing timeouts, a couple of throttles; enterprise unaffected on dedicated pools.

jamie: proposed immediate live mitigations (scoped to pool=runtime-pool-7 and tier!=enterprise):
1) increase batch_wait_ms to 40ms (was 6ms) to allow more aggregation for long sequences
2) increase batch_target_size to 64 (was 24) to improve throughput
3) flip per-tenant small-request fast-path off (it is causing cache churn)
4) temporary soft-rate-limit for free tier (20rps) to keep noise down

chen: i'm +1. trade is that tiny prompt P95 will go up ~120-220ms but overall token throughput and error rate will improve.

olivia: do it, but scope strongly to avoid touching enterprise. add a 30m TTL to rate-limit.

jamie: applying config updates now. commands:
```bash
# scale batching window for pool-7 non-enterprise
curl -s -X POST "https://infra-admin.internal/v1/patch-config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"scope":{"pool":"runtime-pool-7","tier":"!enterprise"}, "patch":{"batch_wait_ms":"40","batch_target_size":"64"}}'

# disable small-request fast-path
curl -s -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"flag":"small-request-fastpath","value":"false","scope":{"pool":"runtime-pool-7","tier":"!enterprise"}}'

# create temp rate limit for free tier
curl -s -X POST "https://quota.internal/v1/rules" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"id":"temp-free-1865456789","selector":{"tier":"free","pool":"runtime-pool-7"},"limit":{"rps":20},"ttl":1800}'
```

ops-bot: config patch accepted -> rolling to nodes (6/6). flag toggle queued. quota rule temp-free-1865456789 created.

chen: initial metrics 45s after roll: queue depth down ~55%, error rate down from 3.1% -> 0.4%, overall tokens/sec recovered. P95 (<=64 tokens) increased ~160ms, P99 reduced by ~300ms. GC events dropping.

luis: i'll notify impacted dev/free customers with a short blurb noting temporary throttle and expected slight slowdown.

jamie: leaving watch. if stable for 20m we can relax TTL or tune further. I'll hand off at 03:00 UTC to olivia for monitoring.

olivia: got it. i'll keep an eye on queue/GC and 1) prepare quick rollback commands if the change causes unexpected regressions and 2) draft action items for postmortem.

jamie: rollback snippets if needed:
```bash
# revert batching
curl -s -X POST "https://infra-admin.internal/v1/patch-config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"scope":{"pool":"runtime-pool-7","tier":"!enterprise"}, "patch":{"batch_wait_ms":"6","batch_target_size":"24"}}'

# re-enable fast-path
curl -s -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"flag":"small-request-fastpath","value":"true","scope":{"pool":"runtime-pool-7","tier":"!enterprise"}}'

# delete temp rate limit
curl -s -X DELETE "https://quota.internal/v1/rules/temp-free-1865456789" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

olivia: quick canary shows enterprise path unchanged. non-enterprise slice stable, errors down. leaving alert in watch for 30m.

ops-bot: monitoring note: watch windows enabled (30m) for pool=runtime-pool-7.

chen: follow-ups for postmortem: 1) add adaptive batching profile to detect tiny-request-heavy workload and automatically bump batch_wait or batch_target_size per-tenant 2) improve runtime telemetry to expose batch shape histograms per-tenant 3) autotuner to reduce manual interventions.

luis: agreed. i'll add a customer-facing changelog entry about the temporary throttle.

jamie: incident mitigated. switching status in system. handing over to olivia for 30m watch. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: incident 1865456789 marked mitigated by jamie at 2026-03-15T03:02:00Z."
